"""One-episode Franka pick for the wooden pestle with jagged top."""
import sys, time
import numpy as np
from PIL import Image
sys.path.insert(0, "/opt/tools")
from rcb_client import Robot

CAM = "droid_shoulder_light_randomization"
WRIST = "wrist_camera_zed_mini"
TARGET_XY = np.array([5.92, 9.22])


def observe(r, filename=None, depth=True):
    o = r.get_obs(depth=depth)
    if filename:
        Image.fromarray(o.last[CAM]).save(filename)
    return o


def move_joints(r, q_goal, gripper, duration_s=1.584, note="move"):
    o = r.get_obs(cameras=[], video="none")
    q0 = np.asarray(o.meta["proprio"]["now"][:7], dtype=float)
    q1 = np.asarray(q_goal, dtype=float)
    n = max(2, int(round(duration_s / 0.066)))
    actions = np.column_stack([q0[None, :] + (q1-q0)[None, :] * np.linspace(1/n, 1, n)[:, None],
                               np.full(n, float(gripper))])
    return r.submit("joint_position", actions, dt=0.066, interpolate="linear", note=note)


def main():
    r = Robot()
    o = observe(r, "/app/output/initial.png")
    print("initial", r.status(), "tcp", o.meta["proprio"]["now"][22:29])
    # Stage 1: hover above the pestle; inspect before lowering.
    now = np.asarray(o.meta["proprio"]["now"], dtype=float)
    q = now[:7]
    quat = now[25:29]
    ik = r.ik({"gripper": [*TARGET_XY, 1.40, *quat]}, seed=q)
    if not ik.get("ok"):
        raise RuntimeError(f"pregrasp IK failed: {ik}")
    res = move_joints(r, ik["q"], 0, note="open gripper; hover over pestle")
    res.save("/app/output/pregrasp")
    o = observe(r, "/app/output/pregrasp.png")
    print("pregrasp", r.status(), "tcp", o.meta["proprio"]["now"][22:29])


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
PY

"""One-episode side-grasp controller for the wooden pestle with jagged top.

The service has no reset. The status guard prevents replaying this controller into an
already advanced episode. World coordinates are from the calibrated shoulder depth view.
"""
import sys
import numpy as np
from PIL import Image
sys.path.insert(0, "/opt/tools")
from rcb_client import Robot

CAM = "droid_shoulder_light_randomization"
TARGET = np.array([5.92, 9.22])
DOWN = np.array([0.004216017667, -0.14365926385, 0.9887714386, -0.0409308411])
# Local gripper +z faces toward -world-x; the fingers close across world-y.
SIDE = np.array([0.70710678, 0.0, -0.70710678, 0.0])


def observe(r, save=None):
    o = r.get_obs(depth=True)
    if save:
        Image.fromarray(o.last[CAM]).save(save)
    return o


def move_joints(r, q_goal, gripper, duration_s, note):
    """Interpolate joint targets from measured positions at the control period."""
    o = r.get_obs(cameras=[], video="none")
    q0 = np.asarray(o.meta["proprio"]["now"][:7], dtype=float)
    q1 = np.asarray(q_goal, dtype=float)
    n = max(2, int(round(duration_s / 0.066)))
    q_rows = q0[None, :] + (q1 - q0)[None, :] * np.linspace(1 / n, 1, n)[:, None]
    actions = np.column_stack([q_rows, np.full(n, float(gripper))])
    return r.submit("joint_position", actions, dt=0.066, interpolate="linear", note=note)


def move_pose(r, xyz, quat, gripper, duration_s, note):
    o = r.get_obs(cameras=[], video="none")
    p = np.asarray(o.meta["proprio"]["now"], dtype=float)
    ik = r.ik({"gripper": [*xyz, *quat]}, seed=p[:7])
    if not ik.get("ok"):
        raise RuntimeError(f"IK failed for {xyz}: {ik.get('error')}")
    return move_joints(r, ik["q"], gripper, duration_s, note)


def run_episode():
    r = Robot()
    status = r.status()
    if status.get("step", 0) != 0 or status.get("done"):
        print("Episode already advanced; refusing to replay commands:", status)
        return

    o = observe(r, "/app/output/initial.png")
    p = np.asarray(o.meta["proprio"]["now"], dtype=float)
    # Clear the broad jagged head above the table before changing wrist orientation.
    ik = r.ik({"gripper": [*TARGET, 1.43, *DOWN]}, seed=p[:7])
    if not ik.get("ok"):
        raise RuntimeError(f"hover IK failed: {ik.get('error')}")
    move_joints(r, ik["q"], 0, 1.584, "open hover above pestle")

    # Turn the open fingers horizontally, then approach from the robot's east side.
    move_pose(r, [5.92, 9.22, 1.40], SIDE, 0, 1.98, "rotate to horizontal side grasp")
    move_pose(r, [6.02, 9.22, 1.40], SIDE, 0, 0.99, "move to east side")
    move_pose(r, [6.07, 9.22, 1.40], SIDE, 0, 0.66, "clear jagged head")
    move_pose(r, [6.07, 9.22, 1.30], SIDE, 0, 0.528, "lower beside head")
    move_pose(r, [6.07, 9.22, 1.20], SIDE, 0, 0.528, "lower beside head")
    move_pose(r, [6.07, 9.22, 1.15], SIDE, 0, 0.396, "align with narrow shaft")
    move_pose(r, [5.92, 9.22, 1.15], SIDE, 0, 1.056, "advance onto shaft")

    # Allow the fingers time to seat on the shaft before lifting.
    p = np.asarray(r.get_obs(cameras=[], video="none").meta["proprio"]["now"], dtype=float)
    ik = r.ik({"gripper": [5.92, 9.22, 1.15, *SIDE]}, seed=p[:7])
    if not ik.get("ok"):
        raise RuntimeError(f"grasp hold IK failed: {ik.get('error')}")
    move_joints(r, ik["q"], 255, 0.66, "close and seat on shaft")
    move_pose(r, [5.92, 9.22, 1.30], SIDE, 255, 1.32, "lift while gripping")
    o = observe(r, "/app/output/final.png")
    print("final status", r.status())
    print("final tcp", o.meta["proprio"]["now"][22:29])
    print("gripper opening", o.meta["proprio"]["now"][21])


if __name__ == "__main__":
    run_episode()
